# Krish Raja

## Who is Krish Raja

Krish Raja is a commercial leader for content, media and IP businesses, and the founder of Mindmaker. Sixteen years commercialising media, data and technology businesses across London, Sydney and New York. He now builds the AI systems that run commercial engines in that same sector.

## What he does now

- **Mindmaker OS**: a 14-agent, 45-workflow autonomous operating system in production, with stack components licensed to three businesses. It runs the business and is the lab the advisory work comes out of. Mindmaker is the advisory operated with the OS, Mindmaker Live is its content pillar, CTRL is its app, and Fractionl Circle and Fractionl Pulse sit alongside it.
- **Mindmaker** (Founder): a capped advisory practice. A small number of engagements a year, from taking one decision apart to rebuilding how a business decides. Sold at themindmaker.ai.
- **CTRL**: a portable, private memory system that keeps an operator's judgment usable across the tools they work in.

## Commercial track record

- **Nine Entertainment**, Head of Data & Automation: grew data and automation revenue from $9M to $61M in three years. Launched 70+ commercial products. Built a $55M automated marketplace from scratch. Ran a $55M P&L at 22% EBITDA.
- **Captify**, Managing Director APAC: built APAC from $0 to $12M ARR in three years at 22% EBITDA, as first hire scaling to an 18-person team.
- **Nexxen (SingTel)**, Head of Platform & Product Strategy APAC: scaled platform revenue from $4M to $38M across twelve markets through two technology M&As. Launched APAC's first authenticated CTV product.
- **Microsoft UK**: built and deployed automated media campaigns in 2010, years before programmatic had a name.

## Writing and audio

- **Mindmaker Live** (https://live.themindmaker.ai): the editorial channel. Two formats. Built gets to why someone built the thing they built. Paid follows the money in a shift and names the mechanism. Replaces Techonomic and The Builder Economy.
- **Signal & Noise**: podcast with media operators on how AI is reshaping the industry.
- **Teaches on Maven**

## Build work

Fractionl Circle, Fractionl Pulse and Ctrl are live experiments from the operating system, not products for sale.

## Education and recognition

MA Design Strategy (Distinction), University for the Creative Arts. BA English Language and Linguistics, University of Manchester. Harvard Business School Executive Education. Keynote speaker, Sydney Opera House.
